description: The migration proved end to end: an organizer has rewritten the headline, the pitch, and the Why Volunteer blocks from /admin, and the public page renders what they wrote. Before this feature the same edit was a change to volunteerPage.json and a deploy. Read it beside the default volunteer scenarios — the layout is identical and only the words differ, which is the point: the change moved where the copy lives, not how the page is built.
